chart.note: Chart values are rounded to 0.1. The grid starts at the snapshot (lead0 = 0) and stops at the last forecast hour. Observations are stored on those hours; the page draws them only inside the selected models' time range. Overview scores use full precision. Subset scores in the browser use the rounded chart values. d0_obs_hours counts distinct D+0 hours with a temperature observation at any station; a lead's obs_coverage is that same hour count divided by 24 times the releases that forecast the lead.

obs.rule: Per UTC day, the newest obs-YYYYMMDD.final*.csv wins. Otherwise obs-YYYYMMDD.csv (provisional). Hours with no repo file are taken from the newest snapshot obs-public, cleaned as scripts/fetch_obs.py (quality 0/3/5, plausible limits). A final day is not gap-filled from a snapshot. Provisional stays provisional until a final file is published.

provenance.rules: preregistration/v1.md R1–R5, R7, R11. Leads D+k = [24k, 24k+24) h for k = 0..5 (D+0 is the first 24 h; the preregistration's main bands remain D+1..D+3). Common pairs. No filling. Withdrawn snaps excluded.

thresholds.note: For each variable and lead, non-AI series are added from fullest coverage to sparsest while the common station-hours stay at least half of the AI's observed pairs and at least min_pairs. MAE, bias and RMSE in a table all use that one set. The all-leads value is the unweighted mean of the rounded per-lead values.

versions.text: 36 live snapshot days — preliminary (rule R7). Not a claim that a model works.
